name: Stormbringer: Eye of the Storm ignores corpses (#13405)
contract: #13405: Eye of the Storm (806307, ranks 807580-807586) keeps SPELL_ATTR3_ALLOW_AURA_WHILE_DEAD and its periodic triggers 806308 (every-1s pulse) and 806455 (4s blast + 807712 root) keep SPELL_ATTR2_ALLOW_DEAD_TARGET so the storm continues pulsing around a marked target that dies mid-duration onto living nearby enemies (proven by live Ascension combat logs). However, 806308 and 806455 must never damage or root dead units or corpses: spell_ascension_eye_of_the_storm_pulse filters non-living targets out of both TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY and TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY (and clears any dead explicit target before launch/SendSpellGo), and 807712 clears SPELL_ATTR2_ALLOW_DEAD_TARGET. Phase 1 places Eye of the Storm on a living anchor beside a corpse and a living bystander: both living enemies take 806308 pulses, the 806455 blast, and the 807712 root while the corpse takes 0 hits and 0 root. Phase 2 drops the marked anchor to 1 HP so tick 1 kills it mid-duration: the dead anchor takes 0 further 806308 pulses, 0 806455 blasts, and 0 807712 root while the living bystander still takes subsequent 806308 pulses, the 806455 blast, and the 807712 root.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: nearby enemy is killed to leave a corpse within Eye of the Storm's 10 yd radius
SETUP: Shock's GCD clears before casting Eye of the Storm
Let Eye of the Storm run through its 4 s periodic pulses and expiry blast
BASELINE: living marked anchor receives the expiry root
BASELINE: living marked anchor took periodic pulses (806308)
BASELINE: living bystander took periodic pulses (806308)
BASELINE: living marked anchor took the expiry blast (806455)
BASELINE: living bystander took the expiry blast (806455)
BASELINE: living bystander received the expiry root (807712)
DISCRIMINATING: nearby corpse took zero periodic pulse hits (806308)
DISCRIMINATING: nearby corpse took zero expiry blast hits (806455)
DISCRIMINATING: nearby corpse did not receive the expiry root (807712)
SETUP: Phase 1 root expires on bystander before Phase 2
SETUP: first pulse of Eye of the Storm kills the 1 HP marked anchor mid-duration
DISCRIMINATING: storm continues pulsing from the dead anchor and roots the living bystander at expiry
Let the final 4 s tick finish
DISCRIMINATING: dead marked anchor takes zero additional periodic pulse hits (806308)
DISCRIMINATING: dead marked anchor takes zero expiry blast hits (806455)
DISCRIMINATING: dead marked anchor does not receive the expiry root (807712)
DISCRIMINATING: living bystander continues taking periodic pulses (806308) after the anchor dies
DISCRIMINATING: living bystander takes the expiry blast (806455) after the anchor dies
DISCRIMINATING: nearby corpse still has zero periodic pulse hits (806308)
DISCRIMINATING: nearby corpse still has zero expiry blast hits (806455)
